notes: Native JSON-schema transport uses the same generic disclosed answer contract in both arms. Cases, repeats, limits, model aliases and default effort remain the same; the factual score function is unchanged. This changes the delivery protocol, so historical format counts are not directly comparable.
The corrected nullable cause schema permits either a supported explanatory string or JSON null; it contains no hidden fixture truth and does not force the expected answer.

Question dispositions distinguish verified assertions from explicitly anchored declared unknowns. Unknown conclusions remain unverified; final review checks mappings and caller acknowledgments, not arbitrary prose or natural-language question interpretation.

All 16 executions delivered valid native structured objects and passed the unchanged factual scorer. Seven of eight candidate trials saved passed typed final reviews with explicit anchored unknowns. Haiku held-out repeat 2 stopped after 79.007709 seconds and 9 tool calls without preparation, validation, a fresh recovered artifact, plan compilation or final verification; its manual 50 ms observation scored correctly but is not participant-delivered retained verification. This remains a workflow failure.

additional_checks: Paired typed requirement regression: honest unknown passes; unrelated verified link and wrong-ending interval fail; available requested interval cannot be declared unknown; omitted final unknown mapping fails.
Monotonic budget helper regression: 58 of 180 seconds is not exhausted, reset/invalid state rejected.
Native structured parser rejects missing/error payloads without prose extraction; generic schema contains no hidden fixture identities.
Complete nullable native transport preflight; lint, formatting, wrapper synchronization and whitespace checks.
notes: Full Rust suite: 661 tests across 46 suites; updated compiler, stale-report and available-interval controls passed the focused real-verifier integration test.
53 script and 71 evaluation tests passed. One earlier full eval run missed a pre-deadline frame in the existing 300 ms adapter test; focused and full reruns passed without changes to that test.

The compact inventory kept all 18 supported selectors, four root anchors and six review checks in 4768 bytes on the held-out recovered artifact. Full source identity remained in draft assertions and checksum-bound verification.

limitations: Haiku still bypassed the mandatory recovery and final review in one held-out repeat; consistent completion is not established. The compiler guards mappings only when invoked.
Native schema enforcement improves delivery in both arms; its format effect cannot be attributed solely to candidate skill changes.
Small synthetic public cases, two repeats and unblinded implementing-agent inspection do not establish production reliability, causal/prose accuracy or equal-work savings.
Independent adaptation validation covers supplied positive/negative witnesses, not the whole profile population.
Tokens include cached reads/creation and API-equivalent costs differ from subscription billing; unavailable usage remains null.
All earlier format/protocol failures and raw traces remain preserved locally; no post-hoc normalization or inspector replay counts as participant delivery.
Some successive attempts overlapped during startup; host load was not controlled. Timing and cost comparisons are observational.
